supersedes: pb0-v1 (aborted after 3 runs: seed statistics not written, see pb0-v1-aborted.json)
status: Descriptive packet-0 playback baseline + noise, registered before any measured run. Selects no parameter and has no gate (implementation plan 2.4, 5. sor 0).
purpose: Startup, tail-probe, buffer health, stalls and seek of the unchanged playback path on A (upstream) and B (fork main) before SP01-SP04. B is run twice (B, B2) as the noise series. The UX/SLO frame (plan ch. 7) is fixed in writing by the user after this baseline and before any SP gate, never fitted afterwards.

source.manifest_method: sha256 over 'path:git-blob-id' lines of git ls-tree -r HEAD server/app
source.image_B_built_at: 26c84ca (pre-rewrite id of f8118a8, identical tree; app code == main 0515d98)

images.note: B and B2 are the same image (fork main code); C == B until a packet changes code.

topology.network: fresh internal Docker bridge per run (no internet), static addresses
topology.app: image under test, normal start (python -m app.run), HOST_IP = its internal address, HTTPS self-signed; cpuset 0,1, --cpus 2, 1 GiB memory, no swap; fresh named data volume per run
topology.seed: one container per peer (own address; the product allows one connection per IP), tool image, sp_seed_service.py, cpuset 2,3, 256 MiB each; peer 0 also runs the HTTP announce tracker
topology.client: tool image, benchmark_sp_playback.py over real HTTPS, cpuset 4,5
topology.order: for rep in 0..4: for cell: labels rotated by rep (A,B,B2 / B,B2,A / B2,A,B ...)

scenario: Range bytes=0-; after 1 MiB a parallel tail probe of the last 1 MiB; playback at the cell bitrate starts when 2 s are buffered and the tail probe is done; stall when the playhead reaches received data, resume after 1 s; reading pauses at 30 s ahead; 45 s playback; then close and seek to 50% (64 KiB aligned), resume after 1 s, 15 s playback.

analysis.per_cell_and_label: n, median, p95 (nearest rank), min, max; failures and tracebacks counted, never dropped
analysis.noise: J = max(|median(B) - median(B2)|, resolution) per metric and cell; resolution 0.05 s for times (client tick), 1 for counts, 1 MiB for bytes
analysis.a_vs_b: descriptive only (A has the upstream deadlines 2000 + 1000*d ms); no decision

known_harness_properties: Synthetic zero-byte content; piece hashes match, so pieces are natively verified.

The seed speaks TCP only and refuses uTP SYN with ST_RESET at once; libtorrent then reconnects over TCP on its next tick, a constant ~1 s connect offset for every label (reported as first_handshake_after_start_s; ttfb_after_first_handshake_s removes it).
'stall' peers accept block requests and never answer (snubbed/dead peer model).
Raw product logs are not stored (request URLs may carry the API key); only traceback/ERROR line counts.
Host: Docker Desktop (WSL2) on the local Windows machine; other host load is not controlled beyond cpusets.
